resolution: Harness-only correction preserves the frozen VARE replay ordering, VARE sample conversion and group-relative advantages. The strict exact candidate comparison remains unchanged.
root_cause: The crash worker consumed the verified group in member order and called RVL native prompt grouping. The frozen VARE sync arm passes a complete group through PrioritizedReplay.sample_current, which ranks lower-reward failed samples before positives, then supplies VARE group-relative advantages. This changed sample accumulation order and produced a numerically close but non-identical candidate.
